question: Which President of India is known as the Missile Man?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam**, the 11th President of India, is popularly known as the **"Missile Man of India"** due to his significant contributions to India's missile development.
 
• He played a key role in the Indian space program</strong&
